name: Aya, Otosarete
source:
A perverse teacher monopolizes the utterly virginal JK who somehow earned his malice.
Over the course of the night, she's changed forever by the experience. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE137873.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一個變態教師獨佔了不知為何招來他惡意的純潔處女女高中生。短短一夜，她因這段經歷徹底改變。
